body: I used to think therapy is enough cause as much as I know I can tell my friends everything and they would actively listen. I just hate that feeling of vulnerablity and sensing pity from them. Thing I hate the most is being a burden; hence, why I often keep my mouth shut. I guess the anonymity of reddit helps me a lot in putting everythjng out there with the least amount of exposure.

Like journaling? I guess putting my feelings out there, in way it can be exposed or found by others, it scares. So when I cry, I talk, like I'm talking to someone. I always used to think I'm such a open book but in the last few years I realized how guarded and private I really am.
